question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing cheerleader, Claire is playing left winger, Dave is playing fullback, and Eve is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Alice trade positions. Finally, Eve and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) cheerleader
(C) left winger
(D) fullback
(E) benchwarmer
solution:
Row order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve
Initial: center midfielder | cheerleader | left winger | fullback | benchwarmer
1. Claire ↔ Eve: center midfielder | cheerleader | benchwarmer | fullback | left winger
2. Dave ↔ Alice: fullback | cheerleader | benchwarmer | center midfielder | left winger
3. Dave ↔ Claire: fullback | cheerleader | center midfielder | benchwarmer | left winger
4. Eve ↔ Alice: left winger | cheerleader | center midfielder | benchwarmer | fullback
5. Eve ↔ Dave: left winger | cheerleader | center midfielder | fullback | benchwarmer
Eve is the benchwarmer, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
